## Design

### 2026-11-04: I'm not going to make a 3-D mouse, I won't try new things o(╥﹏╥)

**2.23h**

I'm not going to make a 3-D mouse, I won't try new things o(╥﹏╥)

I was going to, but then I switched to a parametric screw together storage pod, honestly much more useful, and more my speed. I could really use one, new room an all ahaha. Although I spent most of this time working on MULTIPLE different ideas, like a Mandalorian Helmet (•﹏•;)

This is seriously not what I expected, but now that I have a plan, I'm so prepared to lock in, let's go!!

### 2026-11-04: Ok I changed the title of the project one last time, but the idea for it is still the same. Honestly, IM STRUGGLING GRAHHH. I got some work done, but this looks nothing like the Merbl Run, and not hal

**2.42h**

Ok I changed the title of the project one last time, but the idea for it is still the same. Honestly, IM STRUGGLING GRAHHH. I got some work done, but this looks nothing like the Merbl Run, and not half as cool, but I'm gonna be honest the Merbl Run guide is harder to follow here. (⇀‸↼‶)

I originally made a hexagon, divided into three and then maybe I would add different compartments from there, but it seemed too simple and honestly ugly ahaha. I tried making another shape that I thought would look better -- THE UNDERTALE HEARTTTT but it ended up being pretty difficult because the shape is pixely and pretty complicated, I tried to extrude cut 3 compartments into the shape instead of using the shell tool, because using it on the Hexagon looked really bad and left gaps IN BETWEEN THE PERIMETERS GRAHHHH, but it didn't work for some reason? I only got two in but it looked incomplete and a waste of space. I think the universe just hates me. (￣□￣)

Well I have a vision but no set plan, so that's that I guess. Uhhhh yeah I'm highkey freehanding this. Extra like 20 minutes declared because of the time I spent mapping out the soul heart on my Ipad, I had to break it into a bunch of shapes!

I learned a lot though, I'm going to be honest, even though it's a small CAD project that looks nothing like the beginner project expected of me, I'm learning things from it, and I'm experimenting with the software to get the end result I want. So this way, I don't feel like I'm half-heartedly making this week's project and being lazy. It looks small, I'm still struggling. (ദ്ദി˙ᗜ˙)

### 2026-11-05: i finished designing my CAD, a main soul compartment, a magnetic lid, and a save point tool caddy, all inspired by undertale. if you didn't notice, i'm beyond exhausted so please excuse me if i make t

**5.17h**

i finished designing my CAD, a main soul compartment, a magnetic lid, and a save point tool caddy, all inspired by undertale. if you didn't notice, i'm beyond exhausted so please excuse me if i make this a bit too brief. i wrote the entire readme in github, and i also found a good source to buy my 3d printed materials from. it's like the sister of JLCPCB, JLC3DP lol. i also found some good magnets, 6x2mm. i honestly prepared to finish my project, here, but apparently i have 1.35hrs more to go. i declared 30 minutes of time outside of lapse, because i ended up sketching out the design of my CAD on my ipad. i used procreate and assisted drawing tools to help me map the sprites accurately onto fusion, though i admit i got a bit lazy. not a lot in my BOM either. overall, i'm pretty proud of this project. :DDD
